messages.author: 2cc2c22c61b42530
messages.subject: Problems Compiling an RcppArmadillo function
parts:
Dear R Shiny Experts,

I have two .c functions that I need to use for my app. I have now re-written the code so that it works with RcppArmadillo and can hence be compiled on your server. Unfortunately I recieve the following error message and am stumped as to where to look:

Warning: running command '/usr/lib/R/bin/R CMD SHLIB file194863673.cpp 2> file194863673.cpp.err.txt' had status 1 Error in compileCode(f, code, language = language, verbose = verbose) : Compilation ERROR, function(s)/method(s) not created! g++: internal compiler error: Killed (program cc1plus) Please submit a full bug report, with preprocessed source if appropriate. See <file:///usr/share/doc/gcc-4.6/README.Bugs> for instructions. make: *** [file194863673.o] Error 4 Calls: runApp ... withVisible -> eval -> eval -> cxxfunction -> compileCode Execution halted

Locally the RcppArmadillo compiles with one warning, which I have chosen to ignore, after all it is just a warning and not an error:

cygwin warning:
  MS-DOS style path detected: C:/PROGRA~1/R/R-30~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf
  Preferred POSIX equivalent is: /cygdrive/c/PROGRA~1/R/R-30~1.2/etc/x64/Makeconf
  CYGWIN environment variable option "nodosfilewarning" turns off this warning.
  Consult the user's guide for more details about POSIX paths:
    http://cygwin.com/cygwin-ug-net/using.html#using-pathnames

The line of code for the compiling:

cxxfunction(signature(x_ ="matrix",y_ ="matrix",w_ ="vec"),code, plugin="RcppArmadillo")

Help would be greatly appreciated. I have been faffing around with this for way too long.

Many Thanks

Marcus

messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Problems Compiling an RcppArmadillo function
parts:
Marcus,

Your app might be hitting a memory limit when compiling for you C++ function. I would try to increase your application size by following the instructions here. And see if that helps.

-Andy
